uomo.aspetto: a stocky man in his fifties with curly grey hair, bulging eyes and a grimacing mouth, in a stained navy tracksuit with white stripes, very sick with the plague: pale skin shiny with sweat

parti.occhi: His eyes are glassy and red-rimmed with high fever, the whites bloodshot, heavy dark rings under them, drops of sweat on his forehead.
parti.bocca: A few small dark red spots on his chapped lips and in the grey stubble of his chin, and a thin dark red line at the corner of his mouth, as after a bad cough; yellowed teeth with a gap.
parti.collo: A thick, sweaty neck with grey stubble: under the jaw a hard swelling the size of an egg, red and shiny.

mani.inquadratura: one big hand held out palm up, from the wrist to the fingertips
mani.segni: Bright red blood smeared in the palm and on the fingers, as if he had just coughed into his hand; cracked knuckles, short dirty nails, sweaty skin.

giovane.aspetto: a very pale young woman in her twenties with long dark hair, bulging tired eyes and sunken cheeks, in a long grey cardigan, sick with a fever

parti.occhi: Her eyes are glassy and shining with fever, the rims red, her cheeks flushed, sweat on her forehead and damp hair stuck to her temples.

nonna.aspetto: a very old woman in her eighties with thin white hair, bulging eyes and a hooked nose, in a quilted dark floral housecoat, sick with a fever

parti.occhi: Very old eyes clouded with milky cataracts, now red-rimmed, watery and glassy with fever, deep wrinkles all around, sweat on her forehead.
